buyer_question: Are leads being answered fast enough before we buy ads or a chatbot?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Masked missed-call log, enquiry source, first-response timestamp band, owner, next action and unresolved reason
ready_to_automate_when: Every enquiry has source, owner, due date, status and human escalation rule
unsafe_claim_boundary: Synthetic row only. Do not claim recovered revenue, booked meetings, conversion uplift or customer demand without measured buyer-approved evidence.

buyer_question: Which repeated admin tasks are safe for AI or workflow automation?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Task name, source system, target system, frequency band, error type, reviewer and exception examples
ready_to_automate_when: The task is repetitive, low-risk, rule-based, reviewable and has a rollback owner
unsafe_claim_boundary: Synthetic row only. Do not claim productivity savings, headcount reduction or AI accuracy without measured post-pilot evidence.

buyer_question: What must be cleaned before connecting automation?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Sample field list, missing source/status/follow-up/consent/lost-reason counts, duplicate notes and owner queue
ready_to_automate_when: Required fields, consent/opt-out notes, owners and stale-record rules are agreed
unsafe_claim_boundary: Synthetic row only. Do not treat this as CRM migration, privacy compliance, legal advice or platform certification.

buyer_question: Which requests need human ownership instead of an AI reply?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Masked request categories, urgency tags, pricing exceptions, complaint flags, refund/escalation markers and answer owner
ready_to_automate_when: Human-review categories, response templates, approval limits and escalation timings are written
unsafe_claim_boundary: Synthetic row only. Do not claim safe autonomous replies, legal/financial advice, refund outcomes or CSAT improvement.

buyer_question: What should the owner see weekly?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Open lead count, SLA misses, stuck tasks, manual-work backlog, risk queue, automation candidate list and blocker owner
ready_to_automate_when: Dashboard fields are understandable, non-sensitive and tied to decisions the owner can actually make
unsafe_claim_boundary: Synthetic row only. Do not claim real-time telemetry, customer interest, ranking, demand or revenue unless connected to verified analytics/CRM data.

buyer_question: What is the smallest safe first workflow?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Workflow scope, inputs, outputs, human approval step, test records, stop rules, rollback owner and public-claim approval
ready_to_automate_when: One narrow workflow is approved with stop conditions, test cases, human handoff and no unsupported public claims
unsafe_claim_boundary: Synthetic row only. Do not claim compliance, security, privacy, legal approval, savings, ROI or transformation success.
